message: It sounds, Erik, like your views on an ideally egalitarian society share a lot with [those Gerry expresses](http://mygiftcoach.org/lit/comments?u=100107&p=770&link=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.wealthbondage.com%2F2003%2F07%2F13.html%23a770). I'd only change your language slightly, to say "I am in no way different *in value* than the next person." But the very existence of difference seems to point us towards valuation. I think maybe I'm just a little more pessimistic than you and [Gerry](http://www.geraldgleason.com/projects/blogs/gerry/blogA0012.html) seem to be.
